data.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

*Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco, San Jose, or Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

The Role

Lambda’s Core Cloud Platform organization builds the software and services that turn large-scale GPU infrastructure into reliable, customer-facing cloud products. The team owns foundational platform capabilities across Managed Kubernetes, resource lifecycle, workload orchestration, cloud APIs, automation, observability, and multi-region operations.

The immediate focus for this role includes evolving Lambda’s Managed Kubernetes platform: making it easier and safer to provision, upgrade, operate, and scale Kubernetes clusters for demanding AI workloads. The platform integrates closely with Lambda’s underlying compute, networking, storage, fleet, and security systems.

As Engineering Manager, you will lead a team building and operating these foundational platform services. You will own the team’s people, execution, technical quality, and production outcomes while partnering with senior engineers to set technical direction. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, Kubernetes, and the customer experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, implementation, and production operation of foundational cloud-platform services.

  • Own the technical roadmap for making the platform more distributed, resilient, observable, and operationally efficient.

  • Ensure the platform operates reliably across a growing multi-datacenter and multi-region fleet, including appropriate handling of partial failures and long-running workflows.

  • Partner with senior and staff engineers to make sound architectural decisions across distributed services, stateful systems, APIs, schedulers, controllers, and automation.

  • Define clear contracts and integration patterns between the cloud platform and the compute, networking, fleet, security, and customer-facing systems around it.

  • Lead and grow a team of senior and staff engineers; hire exceptionally, develop people, maintain a high-performance bar, and address underperformance directly.

  • Own project planning, prioritization, and delivery aligned with Lambda’s business objectives and customer commitments.

  • Establish strong engineering practices across design reviews, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and on-call operations.

  • Collaborate with peer Engineering Managers and cross-functional partners to resolve dependencies and deliver complete customer outcomes.

  • Improve engineering leverage through automation, effective operating mechanisms, and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering.

  • Stay current with developments in Kubernetes, cloud-native infrastructure, GPU orchestration, and platform automation, and apply them where they materially improve Lambda’s platform.

You

  • 4+ years of engineering management experience with a demonstrated track record of growing high-performing teams

  • 7+ years of software engineering IC experience, including principal or staff-level ownership of mission-critical distributed systems

  • 8+ years implementing business-critical services in Python or Go, from conception through production

  • Experience building systems that coordinate across multiple independently-owned infrastructure services (compute, networking, storage) without owning them directly

  • Background in multi-region deployment strategies, cross-datacenter state management, and high-availability architectures

  • Strong track record of owning projects end-to-end: architecture, delivery, operations, and continuous improvement

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration - proven ability to drive alignment across infrastructure, platform, and product teams

Nice to Have

  • Awareness of the evolving bare metal and GPU infrastructure ecosystem - including tools like NVIDIA NiCo (NCX Infra Controller) for DPU-enforced lifecycle automation, BlueField DPU capabilities, and where industry standards for multi-tenant bare metal management are heading

  • Experience evaluating or adopting vendor infrastructure tooling into an existing platform - performing a full migration, having the judgment to assess fit, risk, and timing

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes or Slurm - useful context for how this team integrates with Lambda’s cluster orchestration layer, but not required for the role itself

  • Experience in the AI, ML, or GPU hardware industry

  • Proven track record designing large-scale cloud IaaS platforms from the ground up

  • Exposure to IPO readiness, enterprise compliance, or security requirements at scale

Values We’re Looking For

  • Hands-on when needed: You can get into the details when the team or system needs it without becoming the long-term bottleneck.

  • High accountability: You take responsibility for delivery and production outcomes and do not tolerate systems remaining unreliable.

  • Business and customer alignment: You connect technical priorities to the outcomes that matter for Lambda and its customers.

  • Sound judgment: You make decisions with incomplete information, manage risk, and change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Systems builder: You create teams, processes, and technical foundations that operate effectively without depending on constant intervention.

  • Agency with context: You find responsible paths through obstacles without creating unnecessary risk or operating as a cowboy.

  • Low ego and strong collaboration: You handle disagreement directly, learn when you are wrong, and build productive cross-functional relationships.

  • Learning through failure: You turn operational and organizational failures into stronger systems and lasting improvements.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

  • Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

  • Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

  • We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

  • Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

  • We offer generous cash & equity compensation

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

  • Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

  • 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

  • Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of critical automation platforms. This role will support production automation solutions across multiple technology domains, including RPA, infrastructure automation, validation frameworks, and other strategic automation initiatives. The ideal candidate will focus on operational excellence, system stability, incident management, and continuous improvement, enabling development teams to remain focused on delivering new automation capabilities.

The Site Reliability Engineer coordinates software application testing, quality assurance, configuration, installation and support to ensure smooth, stable and timely implementation of new software and updates to installed applications. Ensures proper controls are established and maintained over test and production systems and software source code. Understands department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas. Makes decisions regarding own work methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations, and requires minimal direction and receives guidance where needed. Follows established guidelines/procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain the health, availability, and performance of automation platforms and production services.
  • Lead incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause investigations to minimize service disruptions.
  • Improve observability through monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational reporting.
  • Partner with development teams to enhance system reliability, scalability, and operational readiness.
  • Support deployment, testing, configuration, and release activities across automation solutions.
  • Drive automation of operational processes to reduce manual effort and improve platform stability.
  • Identify and remediate production risks while implementing the best reliability practices across the Automation Office.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Engineering, DevOps, Application Support, or a related technical role.
  • Experience supporting production applications, platforms, or automation frameworks in a large-scale enterprise environment.
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience with software testing, quality assurance, configuration management, and production deployments.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, source code management, and release management best practices.
  • Experience with automation technologies, scripting, or infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Terraform, RPA, Selenium or any automation technologies).
  • Familiarity with production support methodologies and/or cloud platforms, distributed systems.

data.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Ready for a challenge?

Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.

Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

About this role

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Security & Authentication team. In this role, you will be a key technical contributor responsible for securing, hardening, and scaling the foundational platform infrastructure that our workloads depend on. You will own critical capabilities spanning container image security, Kubernetes platform operations, authentication services, and infrastructure automation; while continuously driving down manual toil through AI-assisted automation.

This is a high-impact role for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of platform engineering, security, and developer enablement, and who is comfortable working independently to solve complex, ambiguous problems.

Location: Canada Remote

Reporting to: Technology Manager

These are some of the key ingredients to the role:

  • Platform Security & Base Images: Remediate high-severity platform vulnerabilities and build CVE-near-free, hardened container base images across the build and distribution pipeline.
  • Kubernetes Operations & Governance: Maintain and scale the Kubernetes platform, utilizing Kyverno policies to strictly enforce admission control, security standards, and cluster governance.
  • Identity & Access Management: Design and maintain secure, highly available platform authentication using Keycloak (primary) alongside working knowledge of IdentityServer.
  • AI & Infrastructure Automation: Automate repetitive BAU operations leveraging AI, while building maintainable platform tooling using Python, Go, Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, and Ansible.
  • Cloud & Operations Ownership: Drive AWS infrastructure operations (GCP secondary), partner with cross-functional stakeholders, and participate in an on-call rotation for incident response.

What will you bring to the table?

  • Container & Kubernetes Expertise: Production experience with Docker, Kubernetes platform operations, container hardening, and policy-as-code engines like Kyverno.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Proficiency writing Python and Go tooling, paired with hands-on IaC (Terraform, Terragrunt, Ansible) and CI/CD (GitHub Workflows, ArgoCD).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Strong AWS cloud foundation, with production experience in ECS, EKS, IAM, and Security Hub services.
  • Identity Systems: Practical experience implementing and maintaining authentication services (e.g Keycloak or IdentityServer).
  • Security & System Engineering: Solid Linux troubleshooting skills and hands-on experience managing vulnerability remediation workflows and minimal CVE image pipelines.
  • Ownership & Collaboration: Proactive problem-solving mindset with a passion for leveraging AI to streamline workflows and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners.

At JET, this is on the menu:

Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.

Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day.

What else is cooking?

Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels.

data.title: Sr. Principal Hyperscale Rack Engineer

experience_requirements.text: 60 years of experience

data.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?

  • We are seeking a highly skilled, technically authoritative and customer-facing Sr. Principal Hyperscale Rack Engineer within the Intelligent Infrastructure Segment to lead the architecture, integration, and strategic direction of advanced air and liquid-cooled server and network rack solutions for large-scale hyperscale deployments.

  • This role will serve as the senior technical authority responsible for translating customer requirements into scalable, manufacturable, and commercially viable rack systems.

  • As the Sr. Principal Hyperscale Rack Engineer, youwill operate at the intersection of engineering, customer engagement, and program execution – driving end-to-end rack architecture across mechanical, power, thermal, electrical, and software domains.

  • Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to lead complex programs while influencing both internal and external stakeholders.

What will you do?

  • Serve as the lead architect and development manager for complex rack-level solutions, owning system-level design decisions across mechanical, electrical, power, thermal, networking, and software integration domains.

  • Lead customer-facing technical engagements from RFI/RFQ all the way to first hardware delivery, including design reviews, trade-off discussions, and executive-level conversations.

  • Translate ambiguous or evolving customer requirements into clear program frameworks, ensuring alignment between customer expectations and engineering execution.

  • Demonstrate strong commercial awareness by effectively managing customer expectations, pushing back when requirements introduce risk or inefficiency, and confidently addressing challenging technical and cost-related questions.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across all departments (executives, engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and program) to ensure cohesive solution development with emphasis on Bill of Materials (BOM) management and scheduling.

  • Own rack-level architecture including power distribution design, thermal strategies (air and liquid cooling), cable routing, serviceability, and manufacturability.

  • Provide deep technical guidance on rack infrastructure including PDUs, busbars, liquid cooling systems (CDUs, manifolds, QDs), airflow design, and high-density compute integration.

  • Oversee architecture decisions impacting performance, cost, scalability, and deployment efficiency.

  • Drive program execution from concept through production, ensuring schedules are clearly defined, tracked, and met.

  • Apply strong program management discipline: define milestones, identify risks early, escalate issues proactively, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to commitments.

  • Drive readiness support calls internally from initial NPI scoping to prototyping to mass production, ensuring all systems are operable together from a power, thermal, and software standpoint.

  • Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to continuously refine designs based on deployment feedback and operational learnings.

  • Collaborate with compliance and certification teams to ensure mechanical designs meet global regulatory requirements (e.g., UL, CE, ISTA, ASTM).

  • Mentor and guide engineers across disciplines, establishing best practices in rack system architecture and integration.

  • Understanding of rack installation constraints, maintenance access, and serviceability in rack mechanical infrastructure.

  • Conduct root cause analysis and corrective actions for mechanical failures or field issues.

  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

How will you get here?

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field is required

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in engineering, systems integration, or data center hardware design.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ rack-level (L11) solution design and integration experience.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ switch/server (L10) experience, including compute, storage, or networking hardware integration.

  • Proven ability to drive the development and execution of complex rack solutions for hyperscale or large-scale data center environments, managing 12-18 month lifecycles and portfolios valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

  • Familiarity with industry standards (EIA, ORV3, OCP) and global power architectures.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers in technical and commercially sensitive environments.

  • Strong background in program execution, including schedule ownership, risk management, and cross-functional leadership.

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills – a must.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, integration strategies, and program management.

  • Hands-on experience with prototype fabrication and testing (mechanical S&V, software burn-in and test validation).

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones.

  • Creative, self-motivated, accountable, and team-oriented.

  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight.

  • Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides.

  • Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries.

  • Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices.

  • Familiar with stage-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLM).

  • Able to coach and mentor less experienced engineers.

  • Demonstrated success leading in a highly matrixed environment, driving alignment and execution across cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

  • Ability to travel both domestically and internationally up to 30%.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field is preferred.

  • Extensive experience with liquid-cooled rack deployments in hyperscale or AI/ML infrastructure environments.

  • Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo/Pro-E, Inventor) and FEA software (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus).

  • Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers (CM) a plus.

  • High level knowledge of fluid dynamics, pressure drop calculations, and pipe sizing for glycol-based systems.

  • Proven experience driving compliance and validation for rack configurations, including regulatory standards, safety requirements, and mechanical integrity (shock, vibration, and transit durability).

About Jabil’s Intelligent Infrastructure Group:

  • Headquartered in Austin, TX, with a flagship facility located near The Domain and the Austin FC stadium

  • Growing rapidly, with a team of more than 100 employees and significant expansion planned through 2026

  • Generated over $12 billion in FY25 revenue, driven largely by partnerships with major hyperscale customers

  • Delivers cutting‑edge engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions that power the world's AI infrastructure and global data center ecosystems

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options

  • 401K Match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Time Off

NVIDIA is looking for Senior Cloud Infrastructure and DevOps Solutions Architect to join its ANZ Team, specifically focused on working with our Neo Clouds and their customers on stand up and operational excellence. The scope of these efforts includes a combination of System Building, Kubernetes-based platforms, Automation, Hardware and Networking.

What you'll be doing:

  • Maintain large scale computational and AI infrastructure, focusing on monitoring, logging, workload orchestration (Kubernetes and Linux job schedulers).

  • Optimize scalable, production-ready Kubernetes-based container platforms coordinated with enterprise-grade networking and storage.

  • Serve as a key technical resource, develop, refine, and document standard methodologies and operational guidelines to be shared with internal teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

data.title: Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer - DevOps & Technical Leadership
data.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

data.description:
This is a remote position.

We are seeking a hands-onNetwork / Systems Engineerto design, configure, implement, troubleshoot, and validate network and Microsoft 365 infrastructure projects for our clients.

This role is responsible for turning approved technical designs and project scopes into reliable production environments. Projects may include network infrastructure refreshes, firewall and switch deployments, UniFi implementations, wireless deployments, VLAN segmentation, VPN configuration, Microsoft 365 migrations, multifactor authentication, cloud migrations, and infrastructure cutovers.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working both independently and directly with clients and can take ownership of technical implementation from pre-staging through final validation and documentation.

Requirements

Network Engineering
  • Design and implement LAN/WAN infrastructure according to approved project requirements.
  • Configure and deploy next-generation firewalls, managed switches, wireless access points, controllers, VPN solutions, and related network equipment.
  • Configure VLANs, Layer 3 interfaces, DHCP relay, routing, firewall policies, WAN failover, monitoring, and network segmentation.
  • Configure corporate, guest, voice, wireless-management, security, server, and other required network segments.
  • Configure and manage UniFi Network Controller environments and UniFi switching and wireless infrastructure.
  • Configure LACP, VLAN trunks, port profiles, PoE, spanning-tree, loop protection, DHCP trust, and related switching functions.
  • Implement and validate SSL VPN and remote-access solutions.
  • Configure SNMP monitoring and integrate infrastructure into remote-management platforms.
  • Perform wireless deployments, RF configuration, SSID configuration, client isolation, roaming validation, and wireless performance testing.

Microsoft 365 / Cloud Engineering
  • Support Microsoft 365 tenant configuration and migration projects.
  • Configure migration tooling, source/target connections, service accounts, application consent, and identity mappings.
  • Support Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, and file-server migration activities.
  • Configure and validate Microsoft 365 domains, DNS records, mail flow, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
  • Implement Microsoft 365 Conditional Access and multifactor authentication configurations.
  • Assist with Microsoft Authenticator enrollment and user validation.
  • Perform migration reconciliation, exception analysis, and post-migration validation.

Implementation & Cutover
  • Pre-stage equipment, firmware, configurations, and migration environments before production changes.
  • Perform network and infrastructure cutovers during approved maintenance windows.
  • Gracefully decommission and replace legacy infrastructure.
  • Validate connectivity, routing, authentication, applications, wireless, voice, backups, monitoring, and other in-scope services after implementation.
  • Troubleshoot issues encountered during implementation and determine whether they fall within the approved scope.
  • Support rollback procedures when required.

Documentation
  • Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP inventories, VLAN documentation, switch port maps, wireless information, configuration records, and equipment inventories.
  • Document migration results, exceptions, validation results, and final configurations.
  • Archive relevant legacy configurations and document replaced equipment.
  • Prepare technical handoff information for the support team.

Required Qualifications
  • Demonstrated professional experience in network or systems engineering.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, and network troubleshooting.
  • Experience configuring managed network switches and firewalls.
  • Experience with wireless networking and access-point deployments.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues independently.
  • Experience performing production cutovers and maintenance-window work.
  • Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work directly with clients and communicate technical issues clearly.
  • Ability to follow defined project scopes, implementation plans, and change-control procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Microsoft Entra.
  • Experience with Conditional Access and MFA.

  • Experience with cloud-to-cloud and file-server migrations.
  • Experience with VPN technologies and WAN failover.
  • Experience with wireless heatmap surveys and RF optimization.
  • Experience supporting low-voltage/network infrastructure deployments.
  • Relevant networking or Microsoft certifications.

data.description:
Senior Server Administrator – IT Infrastructure

Role Overview

The Senior Server Administrator is responsible for the design, administration, maintenance, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation’s server and IT infrastructure environment. The role will ensure that infrastructure services remain secure, resilient, highly available, and aligned with business requirements.

The successful candidate will provide senior-level technical expertise across physical and virtual server environments, operating systems, storage, backup, monitoring, patching, and infrastructure security. They will also play a key role in incident resolution, infrastructure projects, service improvements, and technical planning.

Key Responsibilities

Server & Infrastructure Administration

  • Administer and maintain Windows and/or Linux server environments across physical and virtual platforms.
  • Manage server hardware, operating systems, virtualisation platforms, storage, and associated infrastructure services.
  • Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and health, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.
  • Perform server builds, configuration, upgrades, migrations, and decommissioning in accordance with established standards.
  • Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, configuration records, and technical procedures.
  • Ensure infrastructure platforms are appropriately configured for availability, performance, and resilience.

Infrastructure Operations & Support

  • Provide senior-level technical support for infrastructure incidents, service requests, and problems.
  • Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, networking, storage, and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Participate in an on-call or out-of-hours support rota where required.
  • Lead or support the resolution of major incidents and provide root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Work closely with service desk, network, security, application, and other IT teams to resolve cross-functional issues.

Security & Compliance

  • Maintain server security in line with organisational policies and industry best practices.
  • Manage operating system patching, vulnerability remediation, antivirus/endpoint protection, and security configuration.
  • Support security audits, compliance requirements, and infrastructure risk assessments.
  • Implement and maintain appropriate access controls, privileged access, and server hardening standards.
  • Work with cybersecurity teams to investigate and remediate infrastructure security incidents.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Manage and monitor server backup and recovery solutions.
  • Regularly test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Support the development and maintenance of infrastructure disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
  • Ensure critical infrastructure services meet agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives.

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead or contribute to infrastructure projects, including server upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, virtualisation, and technology refresh programmes.
  • Evaluate new technologies and recommend improvements to infrastructure services.
  • Identify opportunities to automate routine administration and improve operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain technical standards, processes, and best-practice procedures.
  • Support capacity planning and future infrastructure strategy.

Stakeholder & Supplier Management

  • Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, business stakeholders, and third-party suppliers.
  • Provide technical guidance and communicate complex infrastructure issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support supplier management, technical reviews, and service improvement activities where required.
  • Provide mentoring and technical guidance to junior infrastructure team members.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in a senior server/infrastructure administration role.
  • Strong experience administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and core infrastructure services.
  • Experience with virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Microsoft Hyper-V.
  • Strong understanding of server hardware, storage, networking, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of server security, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and hardening.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure incidents and performing root-cause analysis.
  • Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT service management processes.
  • Experience working with monitoring and infrastructure management tools.
  • Strong documentation and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical issues.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting/automation technologies.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with enterprise storage technologies.
  • Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery architectures.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Linux, ITIL, or cloud certifications.

Key Competencies

  • Technical expertise: Demonstrates strong knowledge of server and infrastructure technologies.
  • Problem solving: Able to diagnose complex technical problems and develop effective solutions.
  • Ownership: Takes responsibility for infrastructure services and follows issues through to resolution.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly with technical teams, management, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
  • Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities to improve reliability, security, performance, and efficiency.
  • Teamwork: Works effectively across IT teams and supports knowledge sharing.
  • Resilience: Able to manage priorities and remain effective during incidents and high-pressure situations.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Infrastructure availability and reliability.
  • Timely resolution of infrastructure incidents and problems.
  • Successful completion of infrastructure projects and upgrades.
  • Server patching and vulnerability remediation compliance.
  • Backup success rates and successful recovery testing.
  • Infrastructure security and compliance performance.
  • Reduction in recurring incidents and infrastructure-related risks.
  • Quality and accuracy of infrastructure documentation.
  • Delivery of automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

Role Summary

The Senior Server Administrator will be a key member of the IT Infrastructure team, responsible for ensuring the stability, security, resilience, and performance of critical server and infrastructure services. The role requires a proactive and technically capable individual who can manage day-to-day operations while also contributing to strategic infrastructure improvements and business continuity.

data.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
data.description:
Lumexa Imaging is one of the country's largest providers of outpatient medical imaging. With over 5,000 team members and more than 185 outpatient imaging centers across 13 states, our team conducts more than 4 million outpatient studies annually. We are the partner of choice for health systems and radiologists, delivering best-in-class clinical excellence, operations, and state-of-the-art technology across our platform.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Engineer with deep expertise in public cloud Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) across AWS and Microsoft Azure, with strong skills in cloud networking, identity, automation, and platform engineering. The ideal candidate will excel in designing, deploying, and optimizing scalable cloud environments, with a strong emphasis on virtual network architecture (AWS VPC / Azure VNet), inter network connectivity, cloud routing, private service endpoints (AWS PrivateLink / Azure Private Endpoints), DNS (Route 53 / Azure DNS), and hybrid network integrations using VPN and dedicated circuits (AWS Direct Connect / Azure ExpressRoute).

This role requires hands on experience implementing secure, high performance solutions using core cloud services such as compute (EC2 / Azure VMs), identity (IAM / Azure AD), serverless (Lambda / Azure Functions), API management (API Gateway / Azure API Management), monitoring (CloudWatch / Azure Monitor), logging (CloudTrail / Azure Activity Logs), object storage (S3 / Azure Blob), relational databases (RDS / Azure SQL), and load balancing (ELB/ALB/NLB / Azure Load Balancer & Application Gateway).

The engineer will leverage cloud native networking and security controls—including security groups / NSGs, NACLs / Azure Firewall rules, AWS Network Firewall / Azure Firewall, WAF (AWS/Azure), and DDoS protection (AWS Shield / Azure DDoS Protection)—to build resilient, well architected systems aligned with best practices.

The Senior Cloud Engineer will play a key role in modernizing our infrastructure, improving network resiliency, and driving automation through services like CloudFormation / Azure Resource Manager (ARM), Terraform, Systems Manager / Azure Automation, and AWS Config / Azure Policy.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities –

  • Design, implement, and manage multi cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure) with a focus on high availability, scalability, performance, and security.
  • Architect and maintain cloud networking solutions including AWS VPCs / Azure VNets, subnets, routing, load balancing, Transit Gateway / Azure Virtual WAN, PrivateLink / Azure Private Endpoints, and hybrid connectivity using VPN, Direct Connect, and ExpressRoute.
  • Collaborate closely with development, security, and operations teams to deploy and support cloud based applications, services, and platforms across AWS and Azure.
  • Automate provisioning, configuration, and operational workflows using AWS CloudFormation, Azure ARM/Bicep, Terraform, Ansible, and other infrastructure as code tools.
  • Monitor system health, analyze performance metrics, and conduct capacity planning using CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, ensuring reliable and efficient cloud operations.
  • Implement and enforce cloud security best practices, including IAM / Azure AD RBAC governance, network segmentation, encryption, and compliance with frameworks such as HIPAA and Sarbanes Oxley.
  • Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure and networking issues across AWS and Azure, performing root cause analysis and driving long term remediation.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging cloud services, tools, and architectural patterns across AWS and Azure to improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior engineers and cross functional team members.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation for architecture, operational processes, standards, and troubleshooting procedures.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 6 years of hands on experience in cloud engineering or similar roles, with strong experience in AWS and Microsoft Azure.
  • Deep expertise with core cloud services including EC2 / Azure VMs, S3 / Azure Blob, VPC / VNet, IAM / Azure AD, Lambda / Azure Functions, CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, CloudTrail / Azure Activity Logs, RDS / Azure SQL, Route 53 / Azure DNS, ELB/ALB/NLB / Azure Load Balancer & Application Gateway, and Auto Scaling / Azure VM Scale Sets.
  • Strong proficiency in cloud networking concepts such as VPC/VNet design, subnetting, routing, Transit Gateway / Virtual WAN, PrivateLink / Private Endpoints, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, VPN, NACLs / NSGs, security groups, and load balancing strategies.
  • Experience with additional cloud services commonly used in enterprise environments, such as CloudFront / Azure Front Door, SQS/SNS / Azure Service Bus & Event Grid, KMS / Azure Key Vault, EFS/EBS / Azure Files & Managed Disks, SSM / Azure Automation, AWS Config / Azure Policy, and AWS Backup / Azure Backup.
  • Familiarity with cloud security services including AWS WAF / Azure WAF, Shield / Azure DDoS Protection, Network Firewall / Azure Firewall, GuardDuty / Azure Defender, and Security Hub / Azure Security Center.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Azure ARM/Bicep, or similar automation frameworks.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline / Azure DevOps Pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security principles, identity management, and troubleshooting methodologies across AWS and Azure.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, ECS, AKS, and Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Hands on experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as CloudWatch / Azure Monitor, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Familiarity with Linux system administration, shell scripting, and operational tooling.
  • Experience with both AWS and Azure is strongly preferred.
  • AWS and Azure certifications (Solutions Architect, SysOps, DevOps Engineer, or Advanced Networking) are highly desirable.

Lumexa Imaging provides a competitive compensation program to attract, retain, and motivate a high-performance workforce.

Lumexa Imaging is an equal opportunity employer.

data.title: Senior Network Engineer
data.description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support Federal Civil customer in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

LOCATION: This position is remote; however, prefer candidates that are within driving distance to the Washington, DC area.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Network Engineer will serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, optimizing, and sustaining complex network solutions spanning on-premises infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments. The position requires technical expertise, independent problem-solving, and the ability to develop effective solutions to complex network challenges involving multiple technologies and technical disciplines. The successful candidate will collaborate with customer stakeholders, engineering teams, cybersecurity professionals, and program leadership to maintain network availability, performance, and security while supporting infrastructure modernization and evolving mission requirements. This role also provides technical guidance to other engineers and contributes to network architecture, engineering standards, and continuous operational improvement.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have or able to obtain a Public Trust clearance; Must be a US Citizen.

PRIMARY RESPONSBILITIES:

  • Serve as a Senior technical and escalation resource for complex network engineering and operational issues affecting mission-critical enterprise infrastructure.
  • Lead the planning, design, implementation, and optimization of complex network infrastructure solutions across geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments.
  • Independently analyze complex technical challenges involving multiple systems and disciplines, develop engineering solutions, and implement corrective actions that improve network reliability, performance, and security.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, routing redundancy, and network failover.
  • Engineer and support enterprise network security solutions, including Cisco Firepower, Firepower Management Center (FMC), ASA, firewall policies, access controls, and security hardening.
  • Design, implement, and sustain secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions, including Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect and connectivity with external partners and vendors.
  • Engineer and maintain hybrid cloud network connectivity integrating on-premises infrastructure with AWS networking services, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancing.
  • Support enterprise wireless networking and network access control technologies, including Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Lead technical planning and execution of network infrastructure upgrades, modernization initiatives, lifecycle replacements, and security remediation activities.
  • Evaluate network performance, availability, capacity, and emerging technical requirements; recommend and implement improvements to strengthen service delivery and operational resilience.
  • Lead complex incident investigations and root cause analysis, identifying systemic issues and developing sustainable corrective and preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with customer representatives, program leadership, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and service providers to assess requirements, develop technical solutions, and influence network engineering decisions.
  • Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, configuration standards, technical implementation plans, and operational procedures.
  • Support incident, problem, change, and service request management processes while ensuring technical accuracy, documentation, and operational accountability.
  • Provide technical mentorship, peer review, and engineering guidance to junior and mid-level network engineers.
  • Identify opportunities for network automation, standardization, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency, reliability, and security.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 8+ years of relevant network engineering experience; additional education and experience equivalencies may be considered.
  • Advanced hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting complex enterprise network infrastructure in production environments.
  • Expert-level knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and network redundancy and failover.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing technical solutions to complex network problems involving multiple systems, technologies, or engineering disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls, access control policies, and VPN connectivity.
  • Experience supporting Cisco and/or Juniper enterprise networking platforms in complex, multi-vendor environments.
  • Experience designing, implementing, or supporting hybrid cloud network connectivity between on-premises infrastructure and AWS environments.
  • Demonstrated experience independently leading complex network troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective action efforts.
  • Experience planning and executing network infrastructure changes, upgrades, and security remediation activities in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop technical recommendations, communicate complex technical information, and collaborate with customer stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and service providers.
  • Experience producing and maintaining network diagrams, technical documentation, configuration standards, and implementation procedures.
  • Strong communication skills, with experience collaborating directly with customers, vendors, and ISPs to support network design, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.
  • Hands-on experience with Juniper EX/QFX & Junos OS, Cisco ISR & IOS devices, ASA, Firepower & FMC.
  • Demonstrated experience with routing/switching protocols (e.g., BGP, `OSPF, VRF) and core infrastructure services.
  • Hands-on experience managing AWS network infrastructure and hybrid cloud connectivity (e.g., VPC, direct-connect, transit gateways, load balancers) between on-prem and cloud environments.
  • Experience with remote access VPN solutions, including Cisco AnyConnect/Secure Client configuration and support.
  • Experience with virtual computing/virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware/vSphere) as they relate to network design and connectivity.
  • Experience with wireless infrastructure and NAC solutions (e.g., Cisco ISE).
  • Experience with Cisco CUCM/UC voice solutions.
  • Able to obtain a baseline 8140 certification [(IAT Level II) CCNA-Security, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, Security+ CE, CND, SSCP] within 90 days.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Cisco Certified CCNA
  • Cisco Certified CCNP or Juniper JNCIP-ENT.
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki wireless solutions.
  • Experience with Cisco ISE.
  • Experience with Dell switches and OS10.
  • Experience with ServiceNow.

data.title: Principal Architect, AI/ML
data.description:
Zencore is a fast-growing company founded by former Google Cloud leaders, architects, and engineers. We are seeking candidates with significant experience in Google Cloud to join our team. Our engagements aim to eliminate obstacles, reduce risk, and accelerate timelines for customers transitioning to Google and seeking assistance with data and application modernization. We embed within customer teams to provide strategic guidance, facilitate technology decisions, and execute projects in a collaborative, co-development style.

As a member of our Cloud Engineering team, you will be working with fast-paced innovative companies, leveraging AI as the key driver of their transformation. Our clients will look to you as their trusted advisor, someone they can rely on and who will be there to help them along their AI journey. You will be expected to cover a large spectrum of technology topics like model optimization, high-performance training on specialized hardware (TPUs), efficient model serving (vLLM), MLOps, and complex agentic systems.

At Zencore, a Principal Architect is a key technical leader in our engineering organization and acts as an ambassador of our technical and cloud engineering expertise. Principal Architects at Zencore are able to navigate a broad technical range but are specialized in one or more domains. They are responsible for the technical oversight and end-to-end delivery of projects within our professional services business.

Whilst this is remote role, we are only considering US based candidates and do not offer visa sponsorship.

What you will do...

    • Serve as Zencore’s senior-most technical authority on the practical application of advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning.
    • Partner with the sales and business development teams in a pre-sales capacity to scope opportunities, design solutions for proposals, and act as the senior technical voice in client pitches.
    • Lead the architecture and design of sophisticated, secure, and scalable AI solutions for our clients, moving beyond standard API integrations to create genuine competitive advantages.
    • Collaborate closely with Cloud & Data Architects to guarantee the design and deployment of comprehensive client solutions.
    • Address the growing demand for private, data-sovereign AI by designing systems that meet strict GDPR and data privacy requirements. Strive for model explainability and bias mitigation, ensuring solutions adhere to ethical standards and safety guardrails.
    • Architect solutions for hosting, fine-tuning, and optimizing both proprietary (e.g., Gemini, Claude) and open-source (e.g., Llama, Mistral) models on hyperscaler platforms.
    • Lead clients in selecting optimal cloud-native technologies, prioritizing Google Cloud solutions for deploying and scaling production-grade agentic systems.
    • Guide and mentor customers and Zencore's engineering teams on advanced topics, establishing best practices for high-performance training (PyTorch, JAX, TPUs), efficient model serving (vLLM), and complex agentic systems (LangGraph, Langchain, Google ADK).
    • Devise the financial architecture of AI solutions by performing ROI analysis and implementing cost-optimization strategies to ensure large-scale deployments remain economically sustainable for customers.
    • Act as an external thought leader, contributing to the Zencore brand through blog posts, conference presentations, and community engagement.
    • Act as a "player-coach," providing hands-on leadership and fostering a culture of deep technical excellence in AI/ML.

Who we need...

    • Master’s degree in Computer Science, natural sciences, mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience in designing and delivering high-scale AI/ML systems.
    • Extensive experience in a senior or principal architect role with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex, production-grade machine learning systems that have created measurable business value.
    • Deep, hands-on architectural experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) is required.
    • Direct, hands-on experience with Google Cloud (Vertex AI, GKE, TPUs) is a significant plus.
    • Proven expertise in LLM optimization, including techniques for quantization, pruning, efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), and high-performance serving (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM).
    • Hands-on experience with high-performance ML frameworks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch/XLA) for training or fine-tuning large-scale models.
    • Expertise in designing and deploying agentic workflows using both code-centric (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Google ADK) and low-code (e.g., Vertex AI Agent Builder, LangSmith Agent Builder) paradigms.
    • A strong understanding of the architectural patterns required for building secure, private, and data-sovereign AI solutions.
    • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (e.g., LangSmith, LangFuse, Vertex AI Evaluation).
    • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts and their business value to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • A passion for mentoring and a drive for continuous learning in the fast-evolving AI landscape.

We are a fully remote company and offer competitive compensation and benefits.

Zencore is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Zencore is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Experience with Kubernetes Platform Engineering (EKS, AKS, RH OCP/OPP, Rancher)

data.title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer
data.description:
Headquarters: Remote

You're the detection engineer people turn to when they ask "what does Microsoft actually see here?" Not the marketing-slide answer, the real map. Which product emits which telemetry, any anticipated ingestion lags, what table or API it lands in, which license tier gates it, how long it survives before it ages out, and where the documentation quietly disagrees with reality. When a new technique drops, your first instinct is to ask which Microsoft signal would catch it, and whether customers have it switched on.

You also know Microsoft never sits still. Hunting tables appear, columns get renamed, Graph versions retire, capability shuffles between SKUs, previews go GA, features quietly vanish, and native alert logic shifts underneath you. You've got a repeatable way of staying ahead of that churn instead of finding out when a detection stops firing. You're comfortable behind a command line and in front of a customer, including scenarios where the conversation isn’t pleasant. If that's you, we'd love to talk! We have an amazing team and believe you'll love getting to know us.

At Expel, we help businesses bridge the cybersecurity talent gap by providing transparent Managed Detection and Response. To do this we build technology to make sure our security analysts are solving important problems, and automation is helping them make better decisions at every step. We delight in using technology to make security accessible for our customers.

What Expel can do for you

  • Make you one of our recognized authorities on Microsoft detection and response — for our SOC, our engineers, our go-to-market teams, and our customers
  • Give you real ownership of Expel's detection coverage across the whole Microsoft security estate
  • Put Microsoft telemetry from across our customer base in front of you — a breadth of real-world environments no single enterprise gets to see
  • Let you write and tune detections in our own rule engine and watch them run against live signal
  • Treat AI tooling (Claude Code and friends) as a first-class part of how you work, not a side experiment
  • Enable you to learn from analysts, data scientists, engineers, and responders responsible for various components of Expel's product and services
  • Provide access to popular EDR, network, SIEM, identity, and cloud technologies well beyond the Microsoft stack
  • Challenge you to push the boundaries of our security vision

What you can do for Expel

  • Own our detection coverage across Defender XDR, Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, Azure, and Microsoft 365 — from raw signal through to shipped, tuned detections
  • Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft security signal: what exists, known ingestion lag, where it lands, what gates it, how long it's kept, and how far you can trust it
  • Track how that signal changes and turn every material change into a concrete action — catching drift before it costs us efficacy
  • Tell us where Microsoft's native detections are strong enough to lean on, where they're noisy or shallow, and where Expel needs its own layer
  • Make SOC analysts faster by automating Microsoft-specific investigative workflows against the Graph, Defender, Sentinel, and Entra APIs
  • Partner with Engineering on our Microsoft integrations — ingestion, API limits and throttling, and schema mapping
  • Answer the hard questions from the SOC, CS, and Sales — and mentor the people asking them
  • Help customers understand what they're actually covered for, what they're missing, and what turning it on would buy them

What you should bring with you

  • Deep, current, hands-on knowledge of the Microsoft security stack — Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, Cloud Apps), Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, and the Azure and Microsoft 365 control and data planes
  • Fluency in KQL: you can write, read, optimize, and debug non-trivial hunting queries across both Defender Advanced Hunting and Sentinel, and you know how and why the two schemas differ
  • Working knowledge of the Graph and Graph Security APIs, the Defender and Sentinel APIs, and their authentication, permission, versioning, and throttling models
  • A strong grasp of the Entra ID (and legacy Active Directory) identity attack surface — authentication flows, conditional access, OAuth application consent, token theft and replay, hybrid identity and sync, privileged role abuse — and the telemetry each produces
  • Solid understanding of Windows internals and command line tooling, with enough macOS and Linux to keep up with Defender's cross-platform coverage
  • Experience writing, deploying, and tuning custom detections against Microsoft data sets, plus enough non-Microsoft exposure (AWS, GCP, other EDR and SIEM) to keep perspective
  • Proficiency with Python and Sigma, and real fluency using Anthropic tools such as Claude Code to work across systems and data (locally, via MCP, and so on)
  • 5+ years in information technology or security operations, with substantial time spent defending or operating Microsoft environments
  • Excellent tact and diplomacy skills — you can explain Microsoft's limits to an audience that doesn't want to hear about them
  • SC-200, AZ-500, or SC-300 are a plus; demonstrated depth matters considerably more

Work Location

Our headquarters is in Herndon, Virginia. However, we realize that while there is a benefit to in-person interaction, good people don’t all live in Northern Virginia. Remote work is an option for this role.

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $142,900 USD and $207,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $160,000 and $192,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

#LI-Remote

data.description:
Forward Deployed Engineer / Implementation Engineer

Remote, Montreal, QC, Canada. Full time.
Must be located in QC, Canada. Travel up to 25 percent: team meetings, customer site visits when a customer asks for one, and occasional industry events.

About CWS

CWS builds and runs the security and cloud infrastructure companies depend on. We design, deploy, tune and operate production platforms across Montreal, QC, Canada: SIEM onboarding and detection engineering, cloud identity and access, edge and firewall platforms, security programs, data protection, and secure cloud environments built as code. We do not hand off at go-live. We run the managed service on top of what we build, so the systems we deploy stay tuned and defensible.

We work through technology partners and directly with customers. Every engineer here works directly with the founders and owns a real customer outcome from day one.

Role & Responsibilities

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own the customer engagement end to end: you scope the work, architect the solution, build and configure it, prove it holds up, and hand over a system the customer's team can run without you. You are both the engineer and the person accountable for the result.

You carry one to three engagements at a time, spanning cloud and infrastructure delivery (AWS, Google Cloud, infrastructure as code, networking, edge and firewall platforms) and security delivery (tool implementation, tuning, and assessments).

  • Deploy, configure and integrate security and cloud platforms in customer environments, and prove they work before you hand them over.
  • Plan and run your engagements: milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and a weekly status the customer can read in two minutes.
  • Raise risks early, and bring options and a recommendation with them.
  • Write the as-built documentation and runbooks, run the knowledge transfer, and train the customer's team so they can operate without you.
  • Contribute to managed-service work on platforms we run: health checks, tuning, and renewal assessments.
  • Help scope new work: effort estimates, technical input to statements of work, and kickoff material.
  • After each engagement, write down what changed between the plan and what it took, and turn it into an asset the team reuses.

Qualifications

  • Three to five years in security engineering, DevSecOps or platform engineering, or software engineering, including at least one year delivering into environments you did not own.
  • Hands-on AWS, and working knowledge of Azure or Google Cloud: identity, networking, compute, storage, logging.
  • Networking you can troubleshoot: DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls, load balancing, TLS.
  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) and version control as daily habits.
  • Python or TypeScript at a level where you build your own tooling.
  • Security fundamentals across identity, endpoint, network and cloud posture, and the ability to explain a finding to a non-technical owner.
  • Clear written and spoken English. You write your own status updates, as-builts and runbooks.
  • Comfort working on your own. You take an ambiguous problem, break it down, decide what to build and what to configure, and ask for help early when you need it.

You do not need to match every line. If you meet most of them and you learn fast, apply.

Nice to have:

  • Certifications: a cloud provider certification (security specialty preferred), a firewall or edge platform certification, a SIEM or security operations certification, CISSP, Security+ or a GIAC certification, or Kubernetes.
  • Delivery experience in a consulting, professional services or managed security firm, where you owned a schedule and a customer relationship.
  • French, spoken and written. Part of our delivery is in French.
  • Detection engineering or security automation.
  • Compliance context: SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS.

Compensation and benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • Dedicated mental health days
  • Performance bonuses
  • Learning and certification stipend
  • Home office equipment

Pinterest Technical Program Managers deliver critical and strategic outcomes by directing and scaling engineering effort across organizational and functional boundaries.

Pinterest is looking for a highly technical, experienced Staff TPM to join the Advanced Technology Group (ATG), a research-driven engineering organization advancing Pinterest's ML/AI capabilities. You'll partner directly with senior product and engineering leaders to turn ambitious AI strategy into shipped, reliable, and widely adopted capabilities. This is a high-visibility role spanning research, ML platform, infrastructure, safety, and product teams.

What you'll do:

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream programs across ML research, platform engineering, infrastructure, safety/compliance, and product, aligned under one roadmap, metrics, and governance.
  • Partner closely with the VPs of Product and Engineering to translate strategy into workstreams, staffing, milestones, and clear decision-making.

  • Communicate status, risks, and decisions to executives and cross-functional partners, tailoring technical depth to the audience.

What we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep technical understanding of ML/AI systems (training and post-training, evaluation, model serving, GPU capacity, release management) and platform engineering. You can read design docs and challenge assumptions.
  • Experience with LLM/multimodal model adoption, such as adapting open-source models, evaluation frameworks, and migrating workloads between model providers, is a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to partner with VP and Director-level leaders in Product and Engineering and influence strategy and prioritization.
  • Experience designing planning processes and governance (annual and multi-half planning) across several organizations.
  • Strong analytical skills: SQL, dashboards, and using data from experiments and evaluations to drive decisions.
  • Comfort with high ambiguity, rapidly changing technology, and cross-functional work with Legal, Privacy, and Safety partners.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.
As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. 
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

What you'll do 

  • Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts

  • Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting
